hero.title: Care whenever you need it
hero.body: Reach a Nepali-speaking clinician by voice or video call, day or night, without scheduling a clinic visit first.

one.title: Open around the clock
one.body: The queue stays open through nights, weekends and public holidays, not just office hours.

two.title: In your own language
two.body: Every call happens in Nepali, so you can describe how you feel in the words you actually use.

three.title: Added to your record
three.body: Notes from the call join your personal health record, so the next clinician you see already has the context.

hero.title: One clinician, over time
hero.body: Book routine check-ups and follow-ups with a provider who gets to know your history, instead of starting over with someone new each visit.

one.title: Continuity, not a new stranger
one.body: Return to the same clinician for follow-ups, so context carries over from one visit to the next.

two.title: Preventive, not just reactive
two.body: Regular check-ins catch small things early instead of waiting for a problem to become urgent.

three.title: Referrals when you need one
three.body: If something is outside primary care, your clinician can point you to the right specialty.

hero.title: Support, in private
hero.body: Talk with a licensed therapist or psychiatrist through a private video or voice call, in Nepali, at a time that works for you.

one.title: Private by default
one.body: Sessions are confidential, and nothing about your visit is shared without your say-so.

two.title: Talk it through in Nepali
two.body: Describing feelings is hard enough without translating them — every session happens in your language.

three.title: Choose who you talk to
three.body: Browse provider profiles and pick someone you're comfortable with, rather than being assigned at random.

hero.title: A plan you can actually keep
hero.body: Coaching, tracking and clinical support for weight, built around habits that hold over months, not a diet you abandon in a week.

nutrition.body: Practical eating guidance that fits Nepali meals and routines, not a generic diet plan.

diabetesPrevention.body: Support for lowering your risk before diabetes develops, built on your own numbers over time.

hero.title: Keep your numbers where you want them
hero.body: Ongoing coaching and clinician support for diabetes, with your readings and visits gathered in one place instead of scattered across paper slips.

one.title: Track without the spreadsheet
one.body: Log readings from home and see them alongside your visit history, not in a separate notebook.

two.title: A coach between visits
two.body: Check in with a coach on the weeks you don't see a clinician, instead of going quiet until the next appointment.

three.title: Clinicians who see the trend
three.body: Your provider reviews the pattern over time, not just the single number from today's visit.

hero.title: Steady care for your blood pressure
hero.body: Regular check-ins and clinician support to manage hypertension over the long run, with your readings kept in one running record.

one.title: Readings that tell a story
one.body: One reading says little on its own; a running record shows whether your numbers are actually improving.

two.title: Medication support
two.body: Talk through side effects or timing with a clinician instead of guessing on your own.

three.title: Lifestyle support included
three.body: Coaching on salt, activity and stress sits alongside the medical care, not as an afterthought.

hero.body: Reach a specialist or a second opinion without a long referral chain, for the moments primary care alone can't fully answer.

dermatology.body: Show a specialist what's on your skin and get guidance without waiting weeks for an in-person slot.

expertMedicalOpinion.body: Have a complex diagnosis or treatment plan reviewed by a second, independent clinician.

sleep.body: Work through ongoing sleep trouble with a clinician, rather than living with it indefinitely.

hero.title: Eating that fits your life

one.title: Built around your plate
one.body: Guidance starts from what you actually eat, not a generic meal plan translated after the fact.

two.title: Adjusts as you go
two.body: Check in and revise the plan as your routine, schedule or goals change.

three.title: One record, not a separate app
three.body: Nutrition guidance sits inside the same health record as the rest of your care.

hero.title: Lower your risk before it becomes diabetes
hero.body: Coaching built around your own readings and habits, for the window before prediabetes turns into a diagnosis.

one.title: Starts from your own numbers
one.body: The plan is built around your readings and history, not a generic risk checklist.

two.title: Small changes, tracked
two.body: See whether the changes you're making are actually moving your numbers, visit over visit.

three.title: A clinician when you need one
three.body: Escalate to a clinician directly the moment coaching alone isn't enough.

hero.title: Show a specialist what you're seeing
hero.body: Send photos of a skin concern and talk it through with a dermatology specialist, without a long wait for an in-person slot.

one.title: Photos do the first job
one.body: Share clear photos of the concern so the specialist has something concrete to look at before you even talk.

two.title: Ask about anything visible
two.body: From a persistent rash to a mole you're unsure about, bring whatever is on your skin.

three.title: A record of how it changes
three.body: Photos and notes from each visit stay in your record, so it's easy to see how something has changed.

hero.title: A second, independent read
hero.body: Have a diagnosis or treatment plan reviewed by another clinician before you decide, especially when the stakes are high.

one.title: Bring what you already have
one.body: Share existing reports and records so the second review starts from what's already known, not from scratch.

two.title: An independent review
two.body: The reviewing clinician wasn't involved in the original diagnosis, so the opinion is genuinely separate.

three.title: Something to bring back
three.body: Take the written opinion back to your existing care team to decide together what happens next.

hero.title: Work through what's keeping you up
hero.body: Talk to a clinician about ongoing sleep trouble and get a plan, instead of living with poor sleep as normal.

one.title: Start with what's actually happening
one.body: Describe your nights honestly — the plan starts from your actual pattern, not a generic sleep checklist.

two.title: Not just ‘try to relax’
two.body: Get a real plan to work through, beyond advice you've probably already heard.

three.title: Follow up as it changes
three.body: Check back in as sleep improves or doesn't, and adjust the plan instead of starting over each time.

one.title: Direct, self-service access
one.body: Create your account and start straight away — no referral or insurer sign-off stands between you and the app.

hero.title: Questions people ask before they start
hero.body: Straight answers about language, cost, storage and safety — the things people usually want to know first.

one.question: Is Mero Health available in Nepali?
one.answer: Yes. Nepali is the default language across the site and the assistant; switch to English at any time from the language toggle.

two.question: Do I need health insurance to use it?
two.answer: No. You can create an account and start on the free plan directly, without an insurer, referral or employer plan.

three.question: Where is my health record stored?
three.answer: Wherever you choose — your own Google Drive, kept client-encrypted so only you can read it, or Mero Health's hosted storage. You can change this later.

four.question: Can the assistant handle a medical emergency?
four.answer: The assistant does not diagnose. A deterministic safety check runs before every answer, and anything that looks like an emergency is intercepted first and pointed to appropriate care.

five.question: Does the assistant read everything I upload automatically?
five.answer: Extraction produces a draft first. Only observations you've confirmed or corrected are ever used by the assistant, a share link or an export — a draft never reaches any of those on its own.

six.question: What if the free plan isn't enough?
six.answer: Add hosted storage, automatic document extraction, device sync or clinician consultations as separate modules whenever you need them — an upgrade only adds what you choose.

emergencyServices.body: A deterministic safety layer runs ahead of every assistant response and recognises signs of an emergency, directing the person toward urgent care immediately rather than waiting on a model to decide.

inpatientOutpatient.body: Discharge summaries and follow-up plans stay in a record the patient controls, so outpatient follow-up after a stay doesn't start from zero.
